schemaVersion: No schema change/application; full applicable database schema unverified
dataset: Synthetic org/home/community/division/company schedules. Original TS service and action in isolated test transports; real Supabase SDK with custom fetch; actual compiled React in loopback fixture, off-origin requests blocked. No production data or credentials used.

inventoryCheck.limit: Static register consistency is not runtime/JWT/RLS, persona, concurrency or release acceptance.

testRevision: Original beyond-cap assertion now verifies ID continuation past item004999. Original11 reference batches remain asserted as11 distinct bounded batches; new empty-page probes additionally establish exhaustion. No assertions removed/critical tests skipped.
browserScope: Passed on final UI after role/search/navigation/selection refinement. Database keyset refinement separately verified by focused/actual-SDK/auth/starts/schedule/typecheck/lint checks. Browser transport is stubbed and is not authenticated QA.
remaining: Full-schema/current JWT/RLS, actual-home/assignment authority and independent revocation/parent-move/concurrent-edit races remain unproven.

Browser DTOs are bounded, but original service still collects up to100,000 schedule rows and per-reference PO rows before grouping/search. Database aggregation, server query plans, measured SLOs and snapshot-safe pagination remain open.
Schedule/PO/contact keyset reads exhaust empty sources and surface caps/errors, but embedded child completeness must be proven against real PostgREST/schema.

Dispatch still reads sent events before sending and records event/audit after provider acceptance. Atomic intent/claim/exact-body receipt, ambiguous provider responses, cancellation and durable recovery are missing.
Existing daily company-level suppression can suppress another scoped notice on the same day; reviewed-scope delivery policy and legacy-writer cutover need explicit contract/acceptance.
No authenticated browser/device, full accessibility/dark/mobile, customer policy, archive/restore or delivery sandbox acceptance. No production sends, migrations or deployment.
